content_metadata.description: An educational lecture video presenting factual information about nitrifying bacteria.

qAndA.question: What are the two main groups of nitrifying bacteria?
What is the name of the recently identified group of bacteria capable of completely oxidizing ammonia to nitrate?
What is the preferred source of nitrogen for crop fertilizers?

qAndA.answer: Nitrate is highly soluble, while ammonium is positively charged and more readily retained in soil.
qAndA.question: Why is nitrate more prone to leaching from soils compared to ammonium?

qAndA.answer: The diagram illustrates a modern wastewater treatment system designed to encourage the growth of nitrifying bacteria to reduce ammonia levels before the water is discharged.
